subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the security workflow owners approve these 14 action revisions as one grouped update after representative credentialed jobs pass on the final head?
rationale: The patch contains no mechanical defect, but repository review cannot decide whether the combined upstream execution changes are acceptable for OpenClaw's token, publishing, scanning, and Codex trust boundaries.

options.title: Approve the grouped bump
options.body: Approve after verifying the immutable revisions and successful representative credentialed workflows on the final rebased head.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, Docker publishing, and CodeQL updates from routine setup and maintenance action bumps for narrower review.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped bump
recommendation.body: Approve after verifying the immutable revisions and successful representative credentialed workflows on the final rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNER for every affected workflow and therefore the clearest security-boundary decision owner.
